critical_code_review_comments: Two React files share the same default-export name 'AdminServiceCharges' at /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminServiceCharges.js and /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin/AdminServiceCharges.js. Notification insert on create_service_charge_on_success uses `user_uid=user_id`. Confirm notifications feed queries by `user_uid` in downstream endpoints for consistency.

rca of the issue: There are two files exporting AdminServiceCharges. The App.js lazy import path `@/pages/AdminServiceCharges` (line 616) resolves to the legacy Bill-Payment config file (@/pages/AdminServiceCharges.js, 180 lines). The Phase-3 file is nested under @/pages/Admin/AdminServiceCharges.js (308 lines). Because the resolver picked the shorter path, the /admin/service-charges route (line 985) mounts the wrong component. Reproduction: login as admin, browse to /admin/service-charges, observe 'Service Charges Configuration / Bill Payment & Recharge' page instead of the PRC charge dashboard. Fix: change import to `@/pages/Admin/AdminServiceCharges` OR route the two components under distinct paths.
